_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Course Conduct Information Package
summary: The Course Conduct Information Package gives the Government data to evaluate outsourced training, covering trainee prerequisites, syllabus, organization, scheduling, performance evaluation, and course completion certification.
use_relationship:
The Course Conduct Information Package provides data required by the Government to support outsourcing the conduct of training. This data will provide sufficient information to permit an accurate evaluation of a trainee's capabilities to meet all learning objectives of a course. This data will also identify prerequisite skills and knowledge of trainees entering the course. The course conduct information package also provides information for trainees regarding the training syllabus, training organization, operating, scheduling, etc. It also provides information on an evaluation of the trainee's performance, the trainee evaluation of training, and a certificate of completion of training for the trainee.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the preparation instructions for the content and format of the Course Conduct Information Package.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the performance requirements described by 3.2.6 of MIL-PRF-29612B, and is applicable to the acquisition of training data products. Data product performance evaluation criteria are specified in 4.3.6 of MIL-PRF-29612B.

It is not intended that all the requirements contained herein be applied to every program or program phase. Any individual data requirement contained in this DID is subject to deletion tailoring.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81522C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor format is acceptable. Standard digital data, when specified must be in compliance with the content and format requirements specified in the DoD Data Architecture (DDA) and the Defense Data Dictionary System (DDDS). The deliverable of the product required by this DID meets the intent and requirements of DoDINST 5000.02.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Course Conduct Information Package shall contain the following:

children.title: Front matter.
children.content: The content of front matter shall be in accordance with Appendix A of MIL-PRF-29612B.

children.title: Part 1: Trainee orientation guidance data.
children.content: The trainee orientation guidance data provides the information necessary to describe a new training system. It introduces the trainee to all aspects of the training system (e.g., syllabus, organization, training location, and surrounding area data). The trainee orientation guidance data shall contain the following:

children.title: Resident training.
children.content: The following requirements are applicable for resident training courses:

children.title: Introduction.
children.content: This data shall provide a brief overview of the purpose and expected application of the trainee orientation guidance data.

children.title: Training organization.
children.content: This data shall contain information related to:

children.title: Organization personnel to include relationships, roles, and communication channels.
Support elements to include role and relationships to the training organization.
Training program.
children.content: This data shall contain the following:

children.title: An overview of the instructional features.
The syllabus organization and training sequence.
Training system operation and scheduling.
children.content: This data shall contain the following:

children.title: An overview of trainee roles and responsibilities.
Instructor roles in the learning center.
children.content: This data shall describe the following:

children.title: The response to trainee questions and problems.
The method used to record test scores.
The procedures to check materials in and out.
Operation of equipment.
children.content: The data shall contain operating instructions for:

children.title: Other supporting materials.
children.content: This data shall contain a description of other supporting materials (digital or printed) to include:

children.title: Other supporting material (e.g., lesson sequence guide, facilities layout).
Training equipment exercises.
children.content: This data shall contain a description of:

children.title: Record keeping.
children.content: This data shall contain a description of:

children.title: Quality control.
children.content: This data shall contain:

children.title: A description of the trainee's role in quality control.
Questionnaires and other data collection instruments.
Advanced Distributed Learning (ADL).
children.content: The following requirements are applicable for ADL courses:

children.title: Introduction.
children.content: This data shall provide a brief overview of the purpose and expected application of the ADL trainee orientation guidance data.

children.title: Training organization.
children.content: This data shall contain information related to:

children.title: Organization personnel to include relationships, roles, and communication channels.
Support elements to include role and relationships to the training organization.
Training program.
children.content: This data shall contain the following:

children.title: An overview of the instructional features.
The syllabus organization and training sequence.
Training system operation and scheduling.
children.content: This data shall contain the following:

children.title: An overview of trainee roles and responsibilities.
Instructor roles in an ADL environment.
children.content: This data shall describe the following:

children.title: Student orientation (e.g., Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ), access procedures, passwords, navigation tools for delivery platform).
Teaching in synchronous and asynchronous modes.
Trainee roles in an ADL environment.
children.content: The data shall contain information for:

children.title: Browser requirements and procedures for using.
Download restrictions (e.g., modem speed, file format, file size).
Computer laboratory availability, location, and procedures for access.
Requirements for successful student participation in an ADL environment.
Other supporting materials.
children.content: This data shall contain a description of other supporting materials (digital or printed) to include:

children.title: Quality control.
children.content: This data shall contain:

children.title: Questionnaires and other data collection instruments.
Part 2: Training course standards data.
children.content: A training course standard shall contain the following:

children.title: Body.
children.content: This data shall contain the following topics:

children.title: The purpose of the standard as it relates to the particular course.
A brief description of the general course learning objectives.
Course prerequisites
children.content: shall include a list of all skills, in behavioral terms, required of trainees entering the course. Identify the Learning Objective(s) (LO) requiring the prerequisite skill and identify them parenthetically.

children.title: LOs
children.content: shall include a list of complete behavioral objectives which identify the tasks to be performed by the trainee upon completion of the course. Identify each LO by labeling it with "L.O." followed by a number. The hierarchy of LOs shall be identified by labels assigned to every learning objective (i.e., objectives "L.O. 1.1" and "L.O. 1.2" are directly subordinate to "L.O. 1."). Learning objective construction and sequencing is not a linear process. The numbering typically occurs in parallel as the course material is defined.

children.title: Skill hierarchy
children.content: Include the skill hierarchy, or pyramid of skills which depicts the learning order of all skills to be obtained from the course. The relationship of prerequisite skills to course skills shall also be shown. (This skill hierarchy shall serve as the source document for establishing all course learning objectives.)

children.title: Appendices.
children.content: Appendices shall include the following:

children.title: Equipment list.
children.content: This data shall identify the full name, manufacturer, and part number or other identifier of the equipment the trainee will be able to operate or repair upon successful completion of the course.

children.title: Test equipment list.
children.content: This data shall identify the full name, manufacturer, and part number or other identifier of all test equipment and special fixtures required during the course.

children.title: Publication list.
children.content: This data shall identify the full name, publisher, publication or part number, and date of publication for all publications required to conduct the course. The list shall include the following:

children.title: Part 3: Training materials data.
children.content: The training materials data shall consist of any recorded information suitable for use in establishing and supporting training and shall include the following:

children.title: Operational system overview.
children.content: This data shall describe the configurations and functions of each segment of the operating system, discuss how these segments will interface to operate as an entity to fulfill the mission requirements, and outline the differences between the existing and replacement systems/component.

children.title: Training material.
children.content: This data shall include the following:

children.title: Qualitative and quantitative personnel requirements information.
Contractor's in-house training materials, pamphlets, and other training literature.
Other data and contractor in-house documents suitable for use in planning and conducting training programs.
Part 4: Trainee and training course completion data.
children.content: The trainee and training course completion data provides an evaluation of trainee performance, the course of instruction, and related materials as follows:

children.title: Evaluation of trainee.
children.content: This data is common to both resident and ADL courses, shall consist of the following:

children.title: Hours needed to complete each segment.
The trainee's average of test scores
children.content: given throughout the course in a percentage grade.

children.title: The trainee's final average grade
children.content: (the results from the average of the application, practical, and exam grades).

children.title: Instructor evaluation and comments.
children.content: This data shall contain additional information concerning the trainee's performance and attitude throughout the course. (The trainee's completion of homework assignments and seeking extra help or materials to assist in obtaining the learning objectives should also be considered.) The instructor's evaluation and comments shall include:

children.title: A description of the trainee's willingness to learn
children.content: to participate in class and practical application sessions, and to apply extra effort to the learning situation.

children.title: The trainee's application of facts, principles
children.content: techniques, theories, concepts, procedures, and experiences previously learned to the new learning situation in a percentage grade.

children.title: The trainee's accomplishment of the learning objectives
children.content: during the practical application portion of the course in a percentage grade using the following factors:

children.title: Amount of guidance or supervision needed.
Name of contractor.
children.content: This data shall be the complete name of the primary contractor conducting the course.

children.title: Instructor in charge.
children.content: The signature of the instructor in charge shall be included on the forms.

children.title: Trainee's evaluation of training form.
children.content: This form shall consist of the following sections for recording:

children.title: Resident training form.
children.content: The trainee's evaluation of resident training form shall contain the following:

children.title: Adequacy of time devoted for each session.
Advanced Distributed Learning form.
children.content: The trainee's evaluation of ADL form shall contain the following:

children.title: Adequacy of time devoted for each session.
Instructor evaluation of training.
children.content: This data shall include a description of all problems encountered during the conduct of the course, such as deficient subject coverage, equipment failures, inadequate infrastructure to support ADL, technical problems that could not be easily overcome by the Information Technology (IT) personnel, and documentation deficiencies. Recommendations for any supplemental training which may be required shall also be included.

children.title: Certificate of training.
children.content: The certificate of training shall include the following:
